name: Fake Sick!
desc:
You're not sick. Bacon Mom can't find out.

Skip school with up to 3 friends. Play NOOB QUEST under the blanket fort for cash, and when you hear her slippers on the stairs, hide the GamePal and fake sleep before the door opens. Last until 3 PM and the day is yours. Make it to Friday for Perfect Attendance (At Home).

🤒 Fool her thermometer and cough checks
🎮 Upgrade from a GamePal to the Golden Handheld
🏰 Build your fort up to the MEGA FORT
🗝️ Unlock the house: downstairs, the kitchen, the big TV
🦠 Catch sicknesses with perks and moves: Fever, Pink Eye, Zombie Flu and more
🐶 Watch the dog. He snitches.
🚨 15 ways to get caught. Find them all.

One kid gets caught? Save them with a Doctor's Note.

llm.loop: hide in blanket fort from Bacon Mom -> play handheld for cash/tickets -> hide and fake sleep when she approaches -> survive until 3 PM -> upgrade fort and unlock house
llm.objectives: survive the school day undetected, reach Friday perfect attendance
llm.progression: tickets/cash, handheld upgrades, fort size, house areas, sicknesses with perks
llm.instructions: fake illness, hide the GamePal, last until 3 PM, save caught friends
unique: flips the horror-escape/granny chase into a comedic sneak-around-mom premise
llm.thumbnails: cartoon characters in a blanket fort with Bacon Mom looming, thermometer, handheld; character art showing scenario
llm.complexity_notes: single house with multiple rooms, AI mom, hide mechanics, perks; moderate polish
